title: TickTockReviewDecision/1.0
description: The machine-readable decision record for the G-TICKTOCK-REVIEW gate. Produced by ticktock-skill S4 (the maximum-reviewer trial) at _dev/state/ticktock/g-ticktock-review-decision.json, paired with the human-readable debrief at _dev/reports/analysis/run-debrief__ticktock-skill__<date>.md. Before this artifact exists the gate is ABSENT: tools/ticktock/preflight-ticktock.cjs reads it fail-closed and refuses every non-dry-run cycle. The single field whose value clears the gate is decision.cleared, corroborated by decision.unresolved_findings_total == 0 and by every reviewers[] entry carrying verdict APPROVE with unresolved_findings 0 -- a cleared flag that the roster does not support is a validation failure, not a pass.

decision_id.description: tt-review-<UTC timestamp>. Stable identity for this decision; cited by the journal record and the generation manifest of the first cycle it permits.

produced_by_step.description: The plan step that produced this record. S4 for the ticktock-skill plan.

charter_hash.description: The charter this decision was taken against. A decision does not carry across charters: a new charter is a new run and needs a new decision.

roster_hash.description: The charter's lane_binding_hash at decision time. If the roster hash no longer matches the charter at read time, the decision does not apply.

reviewers.description: One entry per LOCKED lane in the roster, including lanes that were unavailable or timed out. A missing lane is a defect, never an implicit pass.

review_artifact_path.description: Where this lane's raw review output was written. A verdict with no readable artifact is not evidence.

decision.description: THE GATE READ. decision.cleared is the exact field whose value clears G-TICKTOCK-REVIEW; it may be true only when unresolved_findings_total is 0 and every reviewers[] entry is APPROVE with zero unresolved findings.

cleared.description: Strict boolean. Only true clears the gate. Absent, null, or any non-true value is a refusal.

reasons.description: Why not cleared, one entry per failing condition. Empty exactly when cleared is true.

decided_by.description: Who took the decision. The producer of the implementation is never the decider -- a producer never validates its own trial.

operator_stamp.description: Verbatim operator authorization line. Required for SCHEDULE activation (TT-007), which needs BOTH this gate cleared and an explicit stamp; null when the decision clears cycles but not activation.
